headline_stat.name: median precession slope across 5 sessions (223 fields)

stated_limitation: One methodological caveat is worth stating: fields were taken from the pooled direction-specific rate map rather than lap by lap, and spikes were pooled across laps, so lap-to-lap variability in where a field begins adds phase jitter. The reported correlations are therefore, if anything, a lower bound on the strength of precession within single traversals.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (hc-11) dorsal CA1 on a linear track is the canonical dataset for theta entrainment and phase precession.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via LINDI with careful, documented handling of NWB quirks (sampling-period-as-rate, NaN-heavy linearized series, gap-bridging velocity), explicit running-speed and direction splitting, and correct exclusion of the three ring-track sessions.
justification.analysis: Standard and correct methods: Kempter circular-linear regression with a within-field phase-permutation null, Rayleigh test for locking, Skaggs spatial-information filtering.
justification.correctness: Reported numbers reproduce from the committed code and are internally consistent across single-session (63/96, median -202) and pooled (114/223, median -177) figures, with sound statistics and controls.
justification.figures: Figures clearly show place-field tiling, bimodal phase locking, single-field precession bands, and a shuffle-separated population, with units, sample sizes, and examples chosen by correlation strength.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to strong evidence, the shuffle control is honestly interpreted, and specific limitations (pooled-lap jitter as a lower bound, ring-track exclusion) are stated plainly.
